note: Schema and identifiers only. No Airtable record values are recorded here, and none ever enter this repository: the Leads, Customers, Coaching Clients and Coaching Sessions rows live on Tee's VPS alone. The Airtable Credentials table (tblkLdeuGzdtJMw7D) is excluded from the mirror by airtable_mirror.EXCLUDED_TABLE_NAMES, because a data table is readable by every workflow on the instance and so cannot hold a secret.
date_typing: Every Airtable date field is mirrored into a string column. An n8n date column stamps the instance timezone onto a date-only value: measured 2026-09-15, "2026-08-06" read back "2026-08-06T04:00:00.000Z" on this America/New_York instance, which is the previous day west of UTC-4.
